title: ‘We’ve got to make up for lost time’: After lengthy absence, Gabe Jacas faces a new challenge
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Gabe Jacas signed a 4-year, $8.6 million contract with the New England Patriots after lengthy negotiations.
Jacas missed early training sessions due to negotiation delays and a knee procedure but has now joined training camp.
Coach Mike Vrabel acknowledges Jacas's enthusiasm and energy, emphasizing the need to make up for lost time in practice.

title: Skeletal remains found in South Boston home turn out to be animal bones, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Animal bones were found at 8 Glover Court in South Boston, confirmed by authorities after an investigation.
Boston Police initially responded to the scene at 4:15 p.m. Monday, finding bones and shoes in a bag.
The bones were sent to the state medical examiner's office, confirmed animal remains by District Attorney's office spokesperson.

title: Drake Maye, offense finish strong and other takeaways from Day 9 of Patriots training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Drake Maye completed 11 of his final 12 passes during the Patriots' two-minute drill at Day 9 training camp.
Dre'Mont Jones pressured Maye early on, highlighting a strong defensive start for the Patriots in practice.
A.J. Brown dislocated and reset his thumb during practice but was a full participant and effective in drills.

title: Family of Abington teen killed in crash during police chase says car was not stolen
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Sebastian Hamilton, 17, died in a crash after a police chase involving a reportedly stolen SUV in Abington.
Hamilton was driving a car reported as stolen, but family claims a teen passenger took it without parental consent.
Abington police officer involved in the chase is on leave; the incident is under investigation.

title: BC High adds former Patriots special teams ace Matthew Slater to football staff
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Matthew Slater, former Patriots player, joins BC High football staff as Assistant Head Coach for Leadership and Player Development.
Slater earned ten Pro Bowl appearances over 16 seasons with the Patriots, contributing significantly to special teams.
BC High aims to improve after a 4-7 season, with the help of Slater's experience and leadership.

title: Bill Murray makes surprise appearance at Bill Murray movie marathon in New Bedford
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Bill Murray made a surprise appearance at a movie marathon in New Bedford on August 3, 2026.
The event was part of The Zeiterion’s 'Bill Murray Movie Marathon Monday' featuring 400 attendees.
Murray interacted with the audience, answered questions, and expressed appreciation for their support of movie-going.

title: State Police trooper suspended after allegedly stealing Bobcat excavator
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Massachusetts State Police Trooper Joseph Franklin is charged with larceny and witness intimidation related to a stolen Bobcat loader.
Franklin's law enforcement certification was suspended by the POST Commission, citing potential criminal conduct, while he remains suspended with pay.
Franklin involved in a dispute over tree removal; police recovered the Bobcat reported stolen by a contractor in May.

title: All the new movies and TV shows streaming now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Apple TV premieres 'Ted Lasso' Season 4 on August 5, featuring Jason Sudeikis as coach of the women's team.
'Reacher' Season 4 debuts August 14 on Prime Video with Alan Ritchson returning for vigilante justice.
'The Whisper Man', a new movie starring Robert De Niro, premieres on Netflix on August 29.

title: A longtime 7News reporter is signing off
author: John Waller
bullets: Kimberly Bookman, a 7News reporter for 12 years, announced her departure from the Boston news station.
Bookman, a Needham native, joined 7News in August 2014 after working in several other cities.
She plans to remain in the Boston area and hinted at future local projects.

title: Cambridge man dies after being pulled from waters off Martha’s Vineyard
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Kevin Foster, 55, from Cambridge, died after being pulled from Long Point Wildlife Refuge waters off Martha's Vineyard.
First responders and lifeguards rescued multiple swimmers in distress on July 31; Foster later died at the hospital.
State Rep. Marjorie Decker praised Foster's community contributions; a GoFundMe raised over $74,000 for his family.
